name: Diels-Alder Cycloaddition of Butadiene and Ethylene
description: Pericyclic [4+2] cycloaddition between a conjugated diene (1,3-butadiene) and a dienophile (ethylene) forming a stable cyclohexene ring through a concerted aromatic 6-electron transition state.
stages: 1. Suprafacial Approach of Diene and Dienophile
